messages:
Rina: Quick design check: Console should show SLO rules that are routed into the new low-priority lane, but with a distinct state. Hiding them confuses owners when thresholds flip.
Carlos: Agreed. Show them as 'low-priority' with a muted chip and a tooltip explaining routing and why it didn't page.
Jin: For telemetry, emit raw_count, routed_lowpri_count, and an estimated 'would_have_escalated' metric. We should surface those on the SLO card.
Marta: API change proposal: add notify_policy.deprioritization: enum ["off","low_priority","soft_snooze"] plus deprioritization_window_secs and bypass_selectors. Keep backward compat.
Rina: UX idea: SLO header shows a small banner: "Notifications routed to low priority — 420 events in last 24h" and a preview button to simulate which oncall paths would have triggered.
Carlos: Important: deprioritized events must still count toward tenant quotas/costs to avoid abuse. But exclude them from immediate paging math. Emit both counters.
Jin: Implementation note: notifier returns a policy_applied flag per event for tracing so Console can show event timelines. Also add a sampled_estimate if sampling < 1.
Marta: Rollout plan: internal feature flag, then a 48h simulation run for candidate tenants to surface 'would-have-fired' numbers before opt-in.
deploy-bot: notifier-service v2.14 deploy started -> staging
Rina: I'll write a short RFC with schema, telemetry event names, sample dashboard queries, and a small mock. Will include accessibility copy suggestions.
Carlos: Thanks — add a dashboard tile: 'Deprioritization savings' (estimated pages avoided, estimated pager-hours saved).
